title: 0.14.x
description:
Tracking milestone for 0.14.x releases. We'll set this when traiging / merging and cut a new milestone as we approach a release.

title: 15-lopri
description:
We'll use this milestone to collect all PRs that will be shipped in a version of React v15. As they are cherry-picked to the branch, we will determine what version the next release is (minor or patch) based on the changes.

We will create a new milestone and move PRs to that milestone as they are cherry-picked.
